data.title: Season 1  Departure with the Wind:Part 1 — Weekly Update Notice
data.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Polaris Institute released a resource update on October 15, 2026, without server downtime. Please restart your game client to download the latest resources.

Pathfinders, please see below for a summary of this update.

Update Schedule

[Update Compensation] Glimmer × 100

[Eligibility] Pathfinders who completed registration before the version 1.1 update

>>New Home System Content

After this version update, the Home Season event enters a limited-time boost period.

1. Increased the mutation rates of Moondew Radish and Waxing Moon Pepper.

2. Increased the Harvest Moon Points earned from products crafted with Moondew Radish and Waxing Moon Pepper.

Stage 3 of the Home Season, "Harvest Gathering", will open at the times below. Pathfinders can earn rewards by hosting or participating in a Harvest Gathering. Come join in!

[Opening Time]

[Aniimo-Europe] 2026/10/20 20:00 UTC+0

[Aniimo-Americas] 2026/10/20 16:00 UTC-4

[Aniimo-Apac] 2026/10/21 04:00 UTC+8

>>New Outfit Release

[Release Time]

[Aniimo-Europe] 2026/10/16 10:00 UTC+0

[Aniimo-Americas] 2026/10/16 10:00 UTC-4

[Aniimo-Apac] 2026/10/16 10:00 UTC+8

Outfit Set "Batlock Holmes"

Unravel the mysteries of the night in bat-inspired hunting attire.

Go to Shop - Recommended to purchase the new set "Batlock Holmes".

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue that caused skirt clipping in certain situations when wearing the "Forest of Butterfly Dreams" set.

2. Fixed an issue that caused lag when switching in Elite Training.

3. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders could not see the sparkelf statue in Horizon Square.

4. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where a door that requires a key could not be opened even after the key had been consumed.

5. Fixed an issue where the purchase quantity would suddenly change to 1 when buying furniture from the Furniture Store.

6. Fixed an issue where "Gilded Bough Dewpearls" did not change color to match the character's skin tone.

7. Fixed an issue where the image of Inferlupa's Prismana Form was displayed incorrectly in the "Vein Abundance" event.

>>Optimizations & Adjustments

1. Improved batch acceleration controls for Home facilities when using a controller, adding support for Select All.

>>Console Platform Fixes

1. Fixed an issue that caused lag when switching in Elite Training.

2. Fixed an issue where crashes were more likely to occur in Holo-Battle Sim, Holo-Battle Interlink, and NPC duels.

3. Fixed an issue with conflicting buttons in the Home Management interface.

4. Fixed an issue with slow loading in Holo-Battle Interlink, Holo-Battle Sim, and Operation: Egg Heist.

5. Fixed an issue with out-of-order chat messages.

6. Fixed an issue where some interfaces lacked shortcuts.

7. Fixed an issue where, when using a controller, the focus indicator did not match the selected Aniimo, which could cause rare items such as "Sparkling Sigil" to be used on the wrong target.

— Polaris Institute Operations Team
